# ee2-query — provenance

A vendored, offline port of the query-building seam of **Exiled Exchange 2** (MIT, Kvan7), itself a
fork of **Awakened PoE Trade** (MIT, Alexander Drozdov). See `LICENSE.EE2` and `NOTICE`.

What is EE2's code (never hand-edited; regenerated by `desktop/scripts/sync-ee2.mjs`):
- `vendor/bundle.cjs` — esbuild output of EE2's own TypeScript at the tag in `data/MANIFEST.json`:
  `parser/*`, `web/price-check/filters/*`, `web/price-check/trade/{pathofexile-trade,common,RateLimiter,Cache}`,
  `assets/data/index` and their imports (`dot-prop`, `luxon`, `neverthrow`, `@sindresorhus/fnv1a`, `object-hash`
  are bundled from EE2's own lockfile). The module list is in the manifest.
- `data/en/*` — EE2's data files + the `.index.bin` artifacts of `make-index-files.mjs`
  (`client_strings.js` is shipped as `.mjs` so Node imports it). `data/item-drop.json`, `data/patrons.json` are
  loaded by `init()` and not on the query path.
- `data/trade/{items,stats}.json` — GGG's `/api/trade2/data` snapshot taken at sync time; feeds the parser's
  network fallbacks so the port makes zero requests at runtime.

What is ours:
- `shims/*` — replacements for the five EE2 modules the seam touches but must not run here:
  `Config.ts` → `config.js` (AppConfig over injected Prefs), `background/IPC.ts` → `ipc.js` (throws: network
  disabled), `background/Prices.ts` → `prices.js` (inert poe.ninja), `background/TradeData.ts` → `tradedata.js`
  (snapshot-backed), `assets/client-string-loader.ts` → `clientstrings.js`; plus `vue.js` / `vueuse.js`
  (inert reactivity: `RateLimiter.ts` and `common.ts` import `shallowRef`/`shallowReactive`/`createGlobalState`)
  and `fetch.js` (`ee2data://` reads from `data/`, everything else refused). Aliased at bundle time by resolved path.
- `entry.js` — the esbuild entry naming the seam; `index.js` — `buildQuery(raw, prefs)`: the ~40 lines that
  mirror `CheckedItem.vue:159-205` on a cold start (no previous popup → `currency`/`listingType` undefined).
  The goldens under `desktop/test/goldens/ee2-query` are generated by EE2's own code under EE2's own vitest
  setup (`desktop/scripts/ee2-goldens.spec.ts`) and pin these lines byte-for-byte.

Deviations from the roadmap's sketch (§8), and why: one bundle file instead of a per-module tree (same
property set, simpler manifest); EE2's `common.ts`/`RateLimiter.ts` do import Vue, so two more inert shims
exist; the pure deps are bundled from EE2's lockfile rather than added to `desktop/package.json` (better
parity, no version drift). `--src <checkout>` exists for development; releases use a GitHub tag.
